migrations.summary: `openCommand` and `usePaletteKey` moved to `src/components/patterns/command-palette/open.ts`, so the palette can be a chunk of its own.
migrations.instructions: Since 0.37.0 the Command palette loads with `next/dynamic` and is in no page's first load, so the two things a page needs before it opens, `openCommand` and `usePaletteKey`, live in `src/components/patterns/command-palette/open.ts` and the palette's own file no longer exports them. In each file listed, import them from `@/components/patterns/command-palette/open`. Mount the palette the way `src/views/console-chrome.tsx` does, through `dynamic()`, or importing it puts it back in every page's first load.
